source.snapshot_note: The record pins the 2026-11-04 upload. That upload changed only harbor/build_tasks.py, harbor/manifests.jsonl, harbor/README.md, and CHECKSUMS.sha256: the builder now writes per-field tolerances, uses Harbor's no-network mode, declares /logs/agent artifacts and workdir=/tests, and honors staged_name. The task payload and data/tasks.jsonl are unchanged, so the index hash still applies. The generated tree's gold self-test is 250/250 at 1.0.

canonical_repository_status: published; this record pins the uploaded package
known_limitations: Per-task comparisons hold within a measurement batch, not across batches; the leaderboard mixes carried-over and re-run segments.
The tasks index records selection metadata and answers, not a runnable harness input; harbor/ is what turns the package into task directories.
Every package gold has been scored against its own contract by the reference scorer, but no full agent rollout has been re-run from this pin.
The package card and MANIFEST declare the MIT license for the dataset; that declaration is newer than the snapshot this record previously pinned.
